next_question.text: What usually happens at a company right before they start looking for something like Example Postmortem?
next_question.why: The site says who you sell to and what hurts, but not what makes it urgent now.
next_question.example_answer: They pass about 40 engineers and on-call becomes a formal rotation, or they have an outage customers notice.

report.title: ICP interview: question 1
report.summary: What usually happens at a company right before they start looking for something like Example Postmortem? Your site already says you sell to platform engineering teams at Series A to C SaaS companies who lose hours to postmortems.

items.text: Segment: B2B SaaS companies at Series A to Series C with a platform engineering team.
items.label: inferred

items.text: Pain: engineers lose hours writing incident postmortems by hand.
items.label: inferred

items.text: Nice-to-have: already uses PagerDuty or Datadog (the integrations the pricing page lists).
items.label: inferred

items.text: "innovative infra companies" (segment): no category, size or stage a BDR could check.
items.label: vague

items.text: "really care about reliability" (pain): every infra buyer says this; it names no problem.
items.label: vague

Buyer: the site names platform engineering teams but not who signs off on the spend.
